newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 posts first gain in October.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 posts first gain in October.

text.p: The Czech PX50 closed the week with its first gain in October as the index's most heavily capitalised share, SPT Telecom, dominated trading and rose 20 crowns to 3,100.
On Thursday, a rally from major issues failed to pull the PX50 higher and dealers were wary of predicting a sustained recovery in the near future.
Despite the second consecutive day of overall major issue gains, traders maintained their cautionary stance on Friday.
"Some more interest from abroad has been seen but its still taking a long time and for a real wave of buy orders we'll have to wait longer," said Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings.

Vystavel said that SPT Telecom attracted the most activity on the bourse on Friday. SPT accounted for 19.3 million crowns worth of the total 33.3 million crowns traded during the continuous trading session.
SPT accounts for over 20 percent of the PX50's total capitalisation and therefore often has a decisive influence on the direction of the market.
As a highly liquid stock it is also one of the most attractive shares to foreign investors who normally account for around half the trading in major issues.
